key_insight: MatCreatioNN combines reinforcement-learning MOF generation with a multi-stage CGCNN screening funnel to rapidly discover photocatalysts that improve light absorption, redox performance, and stability at the same time.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a scalable, lower-cost route to prioritize synthesizable photocatalysts for environmental remediation and CO2 conversion before expensive experiments.
method: Generated 120,000 MOF candidates with reinforcement learning
Screened 13 photocatalytic descriptors using a multi-stage CGCNN funnel
Used post-hoc motif analysis and simulated XRD to assess performance and synthesizability
evidence_signal: The funnel reduced computational cost by 4.13-fold and identified Cr- and Zn-based MOFs with predicted photocatalytic fitness 1.70±0.25 and 1.20±0.05 times higher than benchmark PCN-224(Zr).
watch_item: Predictions still rely on model inference and simulated validation, so experimental synthesis and real-world photocatalytic testing are needed to confirm performance.
paper_title: MatCreatioNN: Machine learning-guided computational discovery of photocatalysts for environmental applications
